## Overview
Tooling ingestion expands Prismata beyond ASTalyzer and Universe, enabling
semantic tooling, module utilities, and developer workflows.

## Tooling Categories
- CLI utilities  
- Schema editors  
- Module inspectors  
- Canonical diff tools  
- Universe package helpers  

## Ingestion Rules
- Tools must declare canonical metadata  
- Tools must register ingestion version  
- Tools must reuse ASTalyzer primitives  
- Tools must integrate with pcms-2026 menus  

## Example Tool Registration
2026-03-02 09:44:11 [tooling] ingest "canonical-diff"
2026-03-02 09:44:12 [tooling] register version 0.3.1


## Versioning
Tooling ingestion is versioned as:
- tooling-ingest-v1  
- tooling-registry-v1
